summary: Brookfield Asset Management Ltd. files Form 8-K announcing completion of its acquisition of Peakstone Realty Trust. Under the all-cash transaction, Peakstone stockholders received $21.00 per share, valuing the company at approximately $1.2 billion. The deal closed on May 6, 2026, and Peakstone's shares ceased trading on the NYSE. The acquired portfolio includes over 70 industrial and industrial outdoor storage assets, which will integrate into Brookfield's global logistics platform. Advisors were Citigroup, Goldman Sachs, and Morgan Stanley. What to watch: integration execution and the expanded IOS platform. Risk-arb angle: closed deal, no further arb opportunity.
